tasks.title: Security Polish & Remaining Items
tasks.description: Address lower-priority security and policy items from the review.
tasks.details:
288 completed.

288.1: Tightened STARLINK_ERROR_PATTERNS (now more precise: focuses on strong drop signals like 'connection reset by peer', 'broken pipe', 'error sending request for url', specific unavailable phrases, CF 52x codes. Removed overly-broad 'connection refused', 'network error', 'timeout', 'service unavailable' that were causing false-positive retries on real errors. Generic transients now rely on RetryPolicy::should_retry).

288.2: Reviewed shell denylist + allow/denylist coverage.
- Denylist in acp/security.rs::validate_shell_command is comprehensive (rm -rf variants, drive wipes, | bash/sh, base64 -d, reverse shells /dev/tcp, nc/ncat -e, PowerShell -enc/iex/invoke-expression, fork bombs, mkfs, crontab, ld_preload).
- Windows && translation in shell_tools.rs correctly uses $LASTEXITCODE conditionals (prevents unconditional execution).
- Tests exist for: blocked rm -rf, non-zero exit (COR-10), Windows chain failure/success paths.
- Additional coverage in mcp_tools and shell_permissions.
- No major gaps found for the improved && handling or common dangerous patterns. Defence-in-depth is good.

All subtasks of 288 addressed. Security polish items from review closed.
tasks.testStrategy: Run security-related tests + manual review of external access flows.
